Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.label: Dazzle
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.description: Release Stormlight in a single blinding flash. The light is not natural. It sears into the eyes of everyone nearby, leaving them stumbling in a world of white afterimages and blazing spots. For a time they cannot aim, cannot judge distance, cannot see a blade coming until it is already there.
